title: CLCON/22/2006 of PAN SINGH KARKI Vs RAKESH SHARMA and ANR

paras.text:
Contempt Petition No. 22/2006
Hon'ble J.C.S. Rawat,J
 The present contempt petition
has been filed indicating that the order
dated 22.12.2005 had not been
complied with by the contemnors.
Notices were issued to the
contemnors. Now it has been alleged
in para 5 of the affidavit that on
27.07.2006 the District Magistrate,
Champawat had passed the order by
which the impugned order dated
08.12.2005 and 09.12.2005 had been
kept in abeyance and the petitioner is
treated as Naib Tehsildar from
08.12.2005.
 It was further assured by the
learned Standing Counsel that the
salary shall be paid immediately after
the joining of the petitioner. It was
stated by the learned Standing
Counsel that the salary will be paid
within two weeks to the petitioner.
 In view of the above, I dispose
of the contempt petition and the same
is disposed of accordingly.
 The notices issued to the
contemnors are discharged.
 (J.C.S. Rawat, J.)
Dt. : 25.07.2006
Shiv
